The source gloss 'gardener, gardener's helper' is unsupported (it may confuse it with the unrelated Persian گلکار) and has been replaced.

urdu.name: حیدری

faq.a: Haidari is associated with the Arabic form حيدري, whose core sense is of haidar (the lion); nisba.

faq.q: What is the origin of Haidari?
faq.a: Haidari is associated with Arabic. Haidari is the nisba (relational) form of حيدر (Ḥaydar) 'lion' — 'leonine, of Ḥaydar'. The source gloss 'gardener, gardener's helper' is unsupported (it may confuse it with the unrelated Persian گلکار) and has been replaced.
Yes — the underlying form حيدري is Arabic.
Haidari can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
Haidari should not be classified as a Quranic personal name without a direct Quranic basis. False

faq.q: What does Haidari mean in Urdu?
faq.a: In Urdu, Haidari is rendered حیدری and carries the sense حیدر سے منسوب.

faq.q: What does Haidari mean in Persian?
faq.a: In Persian, Haidari is rendered حیدری and carries the sense منسوب به حیدر.
A romanized syllable approximation is hai-da-ri. No IPA transcription is asserted because a verified phonetic transcription was not available.

faq.q: What are the variants of Haidari?
faq.a: Romanization variants include Haidari, haidari. Script forms are حيدري, حیدری, हैदरी.

faq.q: Is Haidari a boy's or girl's name?
faq.a: Documented usage records this form as male. Gender is not inferred from the meaning of the word, and actual use may vary between communities.
